name: Signature Territory Experience
tagline: Journey into the red heart and tropical north of Australia aboard The Ghan
overview: Explore the vast outback and ancient landscapes of Australia's Northern Territory on this 15-day expedition. Ride the legendary Ghan railway between Adelaide, Alice Springs, and Darwin. Deeply immerse in the Red Centre with visits to Standley Chasm, Kings Canyon, and the majestic Uluru. Then, venture into Litchfield and Kakadu National Parks to witness cascading waterfalls, saltwater crocodiles, and thousands of years of Indigenous rock art.
shortDescription: Journey into the red heart and tropical north of Australia aboard The Ghan

quickFacts.climate: Arid desert in the centre; tropical wet/dry in the north
quickFacts.bestSeason: May–September (dry season in the north, cooler outback)

itinerary.title: Depart Adelaide
itinerary.description: Board The Ghan in Adelaide, heading for the Flinders Ranges and beyond. The city streets will give way to rural South Australia before the impressive mountains of the Flinders Ranges come into view. Lunch and dinner will be your introduction to dining on board and set the scene for the meals to come.
highlights: Board the iconic Ghan train in Adelaide
See the beautiful Flinders Ranges from the carriage window
Fine dining and all-inclusive premium drinks on board

itinerary.title: The Ghan & Marla Sunrise
itinerary.description: After a night of fine dining and comfort aboard The Ghan, wake to a breathtaking outback sunrise at remote Marla. Enjoy breakfast, then continue to Alice Springs, where a new journey begins. Meet the Outback Spirit crew for the eight-day Red Centre Explorer tour. Check in to your Alice Springs hotel for a two-night stay, with welcome drinks, a tour briefing, and dinner at the hotel.
highlights: Breathtaking outback sunrise over the red sand at Marla
Arrive in Alice Springs and meet your 4WD safari crew
Welcome drinks and briefing at your Alice Springs hotel

itinerary.title: Simpsons Gap & Desert Park
itinerary.description: Today, explore the natural beauty of Alice Springs and its surrounds. Start with a walk at Simpsons Gap, a sacred Arrernte site, followed by a visit to Standley Chasm, owned and operated by the local Arrernte community. After morning tea, head to the Alice Springs Desert Park for a guided tour that reveals the richness of desert life. In the evening, enjoy a classic outback BBQ and show under the stars.
highlights: Walk Simpsons Gap to spot black-footed rock wallabies
Guided tour of Standley Chasm cultural site
Outback BBQ dinner and local music under the stars

itinerary.title: Alice Springs - Kings Canyon
itinerary.description: Leave Alice Springs and head deeper into the outback. Stop at Ellery Creek for a short walk and morning tea, then visit the striking red cliffs of Ormiston Gorge. After lunch, travel the scenic Mereenie Loop to Kings Canyon in Watarrka National Park. Arrive at Kings Canyon Resort for a two-night stay, with dinner tonight at Carmichael’s, nestled among native bushland—keep an eye out for curious dingoes.
highlights: Walk Ormiston Gorge and swim in the waterhole
Drive the rugged Mereenie Loop 4WD track
Carmichael's restaurant dinner among wild dingo habitats

itinerary.title: Kings Canyon Walks
itinerary.description: This morning, explore Kings Canyon with a choice of two walks—the stunning 6km rim walk or the easier 2.6km creek walk. Optional helicopter flights over the canyon are also available (own expense). After lunch and a rest at the resort, there’s more time for scenic flights or leisure. In the evening, enjoy sunset drinks at the Light-Towers installation, followed by dinner at the Kings Canyon Bar & Grill.
highlights: Hike the spectacular Kings Canyon Rim Walk
Optional scenic helicopter flight over the deep sandstone canyon
Sunset drinks at the Light-Towers light art installation

itinerary.title: Kings Canyon - Uluru
itinerary.description: Today begins with the Karrke Aboriginal Cultural Experience, where you'll learn about bush tucker and traditional medicines. We then travel via Kings Creek Station to Curtin Springs for lunch before arriving at Sails in the Desert Hotel. In the evening, enjoy the Wintjiri Wiru Sunset Dinner—a stunning open-air cultural show with drones, lasers, and projections set against Uluru, paired with cocktails and a gourmet hamper under the stars.
highlights: Karrke Aboriginal cultural talk and bush tucker demo
Stay at premium Sails in the Desert resort
Wintjiri Wiru drone show and dinner over Uluru dunes

itinerary.title: Uluru - Kata Tjuta National Park
itinerary.description: Begin with a guided Walpa Gorge walk, explore Uluru’s cultural heart, then toast sunset at Field of Light.
highlights: Walk through the massive domes of Walpa Gorge
Toast sunset with bubbles and views of Uluru
Walk the illuminated Field of Light art installation

itinerary.title: Mala Walk & Sounds of Silence
itinerary.description: Start the day with an optional Uluru sunrise, followed by breakfast and the Mala Walk, featuring ancient rock art and the serene Kantju Gorge. Enjoy a free afternoon to relax, explore the resort, or take a scenic flight (own expense). In the evening, experience the Sounds of Silence dinner—canapés, a bush-inspired buffet, and stargazing under the desert sky. Return to Sails in the Desert for your final night.
highlights: Sunrise at Uluru and guided Mala Walk to Kantju Gorge
See ancient Indigenous rock paintings
Gourmet Sounds of Silence dinner and outback stargazing

itinerary.title: Uluru - Alice Springs
itinerary.description: Savor a final breakfast before rejoining The Ghan for a scenic northbound journey from Alice Springs in Gold Premium comfort.
highlights: Final morning at Uluru and transfer to Alice Springs
Board The Ghan heading north to Darwin
Gold Premium comfort cabin and fine dining

itinerary.title: Nitmiluk Gorge & Darwin
itinerary.description: Cruise through Nitmiluk Gorge or choose a unique outback experience before ending your Ghan journey in Darwin’s vibrant Waterfront Precinct.
highlights: Morning cruise through spectacular Katherine Gorge
Arrive in Darwin by evening
Stay at Darwin Waterfront hotel

itinerary.title: Darwin - Litchfield - Kakadu
itinerary.description: Embark on your Outback Spirit journey from Darwin to Kakadu via Litchfield’s waterfalls and forests, with a stay at the Crocodile Hotel.
highlights: Venture into Litchfield National Park's monsoon forests
Swim in natural spring-fed waterfall pools
Check in to the unique Crocodile Hotel in Jabiru

itinerary.title: Kakadu National Park
itinerary.description: Take in Kakadu’s grandeur with a scenic flight, Indigenous-guided river cruise, ancient rock art, and sunset serenity.
highlights: Scenic flight over Kakadu's escarpments and waterfalls
Indigenous cruise on the East Alligator River
View ancient rock art at Ubirr and enjoy a sunset view

itinerary.title: Kakadu - Darwin
itinerary.description: Travel from Kakadu through Mary River’s wetlands and Humpty Doo farms, ending your tour in Darwin by evening.
highlights: Spot giant crocodiles on a Mary River wetlands cruise
Stop at the Humpty Doo local mango farms
Check back in to your Darwin hotel

itinerary.title: Darwin Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxed day in Darwin, capped by a sunset cruise with local seafood and fiery Top End skies.
highlights: Free day to explore Darwin's markets or Wave Lagoon
Gourmet sunset cruise on Darwin Harbour
Enjoy local barramundi and fresh prawns

itinerary.title: Depart Darwin
itinerary.description: Check out this morning, wrapping up your 15-day Ultimate Territory Tour with unforgettable outback memories and cultural insight.
highlights: Enjoy breakfast overlooking the harbor
Bespoke private transfer to Darwin Airport

thingsToDo.title: The Ghan Expedition
thingsToDo.description: Ride one of the world's most legendary trains from Adelaide to Darwin in premium luxury.

thingsToDo.title: Wintjiri Wiru Show
thingsToDo.description: Witness Uluru's ancient stories told through an award-winning light show of 1,000 drones and lasers.

thingsToDo.title: Kakadu Scenic Flight
thingsToDo.description: Fly over the massive escarpments and cascading waterfalls of World Heritage Kakadu.

thingsToDo.title: Darwin Sunset Sail
thingsToDo.description: Sail Darwin Harbour on a luxury catamaran and watch a legendary Top End sunset with fresh seafood.

travelTips: Prepare for hot weather and strong sun in the outback and tropical north; bring a fly net and hat.
The Ghan train has strict luggage limits; check large bags and take a smaller cabin bag.
Always follow crocodile safety signs and swim only in designated safe pools in the NT.
Ensure you carry plenty of water (at least 3 liters) when hiking in Uluru or Kings Canyon.

name: Wild Wonders Tasmania
tagline: Encounter rugged wilderness, ancient history, and endemic wildlife in Tasmania
overview: Immerse yourself in the untamed beauty of Australia's island state on this 8-day wild encounter. Discover Hobart's historic streets and Salamanca markets, then cruise through pristine waters to Bruny Island for a deep-to-dish seafood feast. Encounter native wildlife at Bonorong Sanctuary, visit the historic ruins of Port Arthur, walk the spectacular granite coastline of Freycinet National Park, and conclude in Launceston.
shortDescription: Encounter rugged wilderness, ancient history, and endemic wildlife in Tasmania

quickFacts.climate: Cool temperate; clean marine air with four distinct seasons

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hobart
itinerary.description: On arrival in Hobart, you will be met and transferred to your hotel for a 4-night stay.
highlights: Private airport transfer in Hobart
Settle into The Old Woolstore Apartment Hotel
Explore the historic waterfront at leisure

itinerary.title: Hobart Historic Walk
itinerary.description: This morning, join privately guided walk is the perfect option for those who like to have exclusive access to their guide and have the flexibility to schedule the tour when it suits you. Combining the Hobart Historic Walk with a tour of Salamanca and Battery Point, this 3-hour experience with your local guide will give you indepth insights into Hobart’s past and present.
highlights: Private guided 3-hour walking tour
Discover Salamanca Place and Battery Point cottages
Hear stories of whaling, convicts, and colonial architecture

itinerary.title: Deep-to-Dish Seafood Cruise
itinerary.description: Embark on a half-day Deep-to-Dish Tasmanian Seafood Cruise from Hobart, where you’ll savor the freshest seafood straight from the ocean aboard a premier power catamaran. Cruise through pristine waterways to Bruny Island’s Bull Bay, taking in towering cliffs, secluded beaches, and spotting local sea life like dolphins, whales, and seals. Begin with a seasonal fruit platter and Tasmanian cheeses, paired with premium local wines, before diving into freshly caught periwinkles, sea urchins, abalone, rock lobster, oysters, mussels, and Atlantic salmon—all expertly prepared on board.
highlights: Luxury power catamaran cruise to Bruny Island
Feast on abalone, lobster, and oysters caught in front of you
Sample award-winning Tasmanian cheeses and cold-climate wines

itinerary.title: Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary
itinerary.description: This morning is free to experience Hobart at your leisure. At 04.30 pm, meet your group in the hotel lobby to depart on an evening experience to Bonorong Sanctuary where for a 2.5 hour behind the scenes night-tour where you can get close to many of Tasmania’s endemic animals and get a lot of information first-hand.
highlights: Free morning in Hobart (visit MONA or Salamanca)
Behind-the-scenes night tour at Bonorong Sanctuary
Feed hand-reared kangaroos and see Tasmanian Devils feed

itinerary.title: Maria Island National Park
itinerary.description: This morning, travel to the seaside village of Triabunna and board a ferry to cross the Mercury Passage to Maria Island. This unique island national park sits just off Tasmania’s east coast. Enjoy a day of peaceful walking amongst historic ruins, across sweeping bays, rugged fossil cliffs and imposing mountains. This island sanctuary provides an opportunity to view its resident wildlife, including Wombats, Cape Barren Geese, Tasmanian Pademelons, Forester Kangaroo’s and even the Tasmanian Devil in their natural environment. Later this afternoon, continue your journey along Tasmania’s sunny east-coast to Bicheno.
highlights: Ferry crossing to Maria Island sanctuary
Spot wombats, pademelons, and Tasmanian Devils in the wild
Walk the historic ruins of Darlington convict settlement

itinerary.title: Freycinet Wineglass Bay Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel to Coles Bay and embark on the award-winning 4-hour Wineglass Bay cruise. Cruise the spectacular coastline of Freycinet National Park from Coles Bay to Wineglass Bay. Be enthralled by the stunning granite coastline, including the dramatic pink peaks of the Hazards range. Discover a coast dotted with sparkling white sand beaches, including Cooks and Bryans beaches. Explore the inner passage of remote Schouten Island, home to little penguins, before heading into the Tasman Sea towards Wineglass Bay. At dusk you are invited to an informative tour on a private property to get close to the local colony of fairy penguins nesting and breeding in the dunes.
highlights: Vista-lounge cruise to iconic Wineglass Bay
See the pink granite Hazards range and secret sea caves
Evening guided fairy penguin nesting tour in Bicheno

itinerary.title: Bay of Fires & Launceston
itinerary.description: Continue your journey along the East Coast and visit the stunning orange-lichen covered granite rocks of the Bay of Fires conservation area. Take the opportunity to wander around, explore the whitest sandy beaches and the turquoise waters. Travel on to the St. Columba Falls, the highest waterfalls in Tasmania and through lush and green valleys before we arrive in Launceston.
highlights: Explore the orange-lichen rocks of Bay of Fires
Walk through temperate rainforest to St. Columba Falls
Settle in to Launceston Grand Chancellor Hotel

itinerary.title: Cataract Gorge & Departure
itinerary.description: This morning, enjoy a city introduction of Launceston and visit the stunning Cataract Gorge, where the South Esk river forces its way through sheer granite rocks before the tour ends at midday at the Launceston transit centre. You will be met and transferred to Launceston Airport.
highlights: Visit Cataract Gorge in Launceston
Ride the world's longest single-span chairlift (optional)
Private transfer to Launceston Airport for departure

thingsToDo.title: Salamanca Market Walk
thingsToDo.description: Stroll the Saturday Salamanca markets for local woolens, woodcrafts, and artisan cheeses.

thingsToDo.title: Seafood Catamaran Cruise
thingsToDo.description: Cruise to Bruny Island and feast on lobster, abalone, and oysters gathered fresh from the waters.

thingsToDo.title: Maria Island Wilderness
thingsToDo.description: Walk among wild wombats and explore convict history on a car-free island sanctuary.

thingsToDo.title: Fairy Penguin Tour
thingsToDo.description: Watch colonies of little penguins return to their nests in the sand dunes at dusk in Bicheno.

travelTips: Tasmania's weather can change rapidly; always pack a windproof and waterproof jacket.
Bring sturdy walking shoes or hiking boots, as the trails in national parks are rocky and uneven.
National park entry passes are required; these are typically included in your guided tour package.
Tasmania has strict biosecurity laws; do not bring fresh fruit or vegetables onto the island.

name: Tasmania Uncovered
tagline: A comprehensive self-drive expedition through Tasmania's spectacular landscapes
overview: Uncover the very best of Tasmania on this 11-day self-drive adventure. Drive through dramatic valleys, historic mining towns, and coastal villages. Discover Hobart's historic charm, the convict history of Port Arthur, the pink granite peaks of Freycinet, the second-largest city of Launceston, the rugged beauty of Cradle Mountain, and the historic harbor of Strahan. Enjoy the independence of a road trip paired with premium boutique lodgings and curated cruises.
shortDescription: A comprehensive self-drive expedition through Tasmania's spectacular landscapes

quickFacts.climate: Cool temperate; crisp winters and pleasant, sunny summers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hobart
itinerary.description: Arrive in Hobart for a 2-night stay and enjoy a flexible, private walking tour through its historic heart.
highlights: Airport pickup and transfer to The Henry Jones Art Hotel
3-hour private guided walk of Hobart's historic docks
Explore the historic waterfront and craft breweries

itinerary.title: Bruny Island Safari
itinerary.description: Embark on a Bruny Island adventure from Hobart, blending scenic views, gourmet tastings, and lighthouse history.
highlights: Guided 4WD safari across Bruny Island
Scenic walks at Adventure Bay and Cape Bruny Lighthouse
Oyster, cheese, and berry tastings with a local lunch

itinerary.title: Hobart - Port Arthur - Freycinet
itinerary.description: Drive from Hobart to Freycinet via Port Arthur’s convict history, coastal wonders, and charming country towns.
highlights: Pick up your hire car and drive to Port Arthur historic site
Visit Tasman Arch and the Devil's Kitchen sea cliffs
Drive to Coles Bay and check in to Freycinet Lodge

itinerary.title: Wineglass Bay Cruise
itinerary.description: Cruise Freycinet’s stunning coast from Coles Bay to Wineglass Bay, spotting wildlife and sea caves en route.
highlights: Vista-lounge Wineglass Bay cruise
See pink granite peaks and white-sand beaches
Look out for dolphins, sea eagles, and seals

itinerary.title: Coles Bay - Launceston
itinerary.description: Drive from Freycinet to Launceston via scenic valleys and historic Evandale, then indulge in wine and lunch at Josef Chromy.
highlights: Drive through the northern Midlands agricultural belt
Lunch and estate wine tasting at Josef Chromy
Settle in to Verge Luxe room at Hotel Verge Launceston

itinerary.title: Launceston - Cradle Mountain
itinerary.description: Journey through Tasmania’s charming villages to Cradle Mountain, then meet Tasmanian Devils up close during After Dark Feeding.
highlights: Drive through Sheffield, the town of murals
Settle into Cradle Mountain Hotel
Guided after-dark Tasmanian Devil feeding tour

itinerary.title: Cradle Mountain Discovery
itinerary.description: Spend a free day exploring Cradle Mountain’s wild beauty—Dove Lake, native wildlife, waterfalls, and stargazing await.
highlights: Walk the famous Dove Lake Circuit trail under Cradle Mountain
Spot wombats grazing in the valley at dusk
Clear night stargazing in the alpine wilderness

itinerary.title: Cradle Mountain - Strahan
itinerary.description: Descend from Cradle Mountain through historic mining towns to the charming coastal village of Strahan.
highlights: Drive through Zeehan and Rosebery historic mining hubs
Check in to Strahan Village overlooking Macquarie Harbour
Watch the local play 'The Ship That Never Was' (optional)

itinerary.title: Gordon River Cruise
itinerary.description: Cruise the Gordon River aboard Spirit of the Wild, exploring rainforest trails and convict history at Sarah Island.
highlights: Gordon River cruise aboard the silent Spirit of the Wild
Walk through ancient temperate rainforests
Guided tour of Sarah Island's harsh convict ruins

itinerary.title: Strahan - Hobart
itinerary.description: Drive from Strahan to Hobart via the scenic Lyell Highway, passing mountains, valleys, and charming country towns.
highlights: Drive the winding, spectacular Lyell Highway
Stop at Queenstown's gravel mountains and Lake St Clair
Final night at The Henry Jones Art Hotel in Hobart

itinerary.title: Depart Hobart
itinerary.description: After breakfast, return your rental vehicle to Hobart Airport prior your departing flight.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast provisions
Drive to Hobart Airport and return rental car

thingsToDo.title: Self-Drive Freedom
thingsToDo.description: Navigate Tasmania's winding, scenic highways with the independence of a premium hire car.

thingsToDo.title: Silent Gordon River Cruise
thingsToDo.description: Experience Macquarie Harbour and the Gordon River aboard a silent hybrid-propulsion vessel.

thingsToDo.title: Dove Lake Walk
thingsToDo.description: Hike the 6km Dove Lake loop beneath the dramatic, snow-dusted dolerite columns of Cradle Mountain.

thingsToDo.title: Devils @ Cradle
thingsToDo.description: Visit a conservation sanctuary to see and learn about the endangered Tasmanian Devil.

travelTips: Hire cars in Tasmania have strict rules against driving on unsealed roads or after dusk (due to wildlife).
Fuel stations can be sparse in the Western wilderness; keep your tank topped up.
Bring warm clothing even in summer, as Cradle Mountain is an alpine region and cold front storms are common.
Buy a Parks Pass online before starting your journey to cover all national park entries.

name: Trails & Serenity
tagline: A premium journey of luxury lodges, outback rail, and coastal islands
overview: Embark on a unique 14-day vacation blending luxury lodge stays with the legendary Ghan railway. Settle into Finniss River Lodge near Darwin for outback safaris and airboat wildlife tours. Board The Ghan to travel south through Alice Springs and Coober Pedy to Adelaide. Savor Sequoia Lodge in the Adelaide Hills, then fly to Kangaroo Island for a 3-night stay at the world-renowned Southern Ocean Lodge, surrounded by sea lions and dramatic coastal vistas.
shortDescription: A premium journey of luxury lodges, outback rail, and coastal islands

quickFacts.climate: Tropical north, hot dry outback, Mediterranean south

itinerary.title: Darwin - Finniss River Lodge
itinerary.description: This morning, transfer by vehicle from Darwin to Finnis River Lodge (90 minutes). On arrival check-in to your suite and prepare yourself for an unforgettable day of adventure and relaxation.
highlights: Private transfer from Darwin to Finniss River Lodge
Check in to a luxury lodge suite on a working cattle station
Chef-prepared dinner with locally sourced outback ingredients

itinerary.title: Rakula Safaris
itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in Finniss River Lodge’s daily guided adventures, from walkabout safaris to airboat wildlife spotting.
highlights: Airboat tour through freshwater wetlands spotting birds and crocs
Guided 4WD wildlife safari on the pastoral estate
Sundowners overlooking the vast black soil floodplains

itinerary.title: Rakula Leisure & Touring
itinerary.description: Continue exploring the wetland trails, take a helicopter flight to a remote swimming hole (optional), or relax by the pool.
highlights: Wetland birdwatching and nature walks
Chef's tasting menu paired with premium Australian wines
Afternoon at leisure by the pool overlooking the wetlands

itinerary.title: Rakula - Darwin
itinerary.description: After a relaxing morning at the Lodge, transfer by vehicle to Darwin for an overnight stay. The remainder of the day is at leisure in Darwin.
highlights: Morning relaxation at Finniss River
Transfer back to Darwin
Stay at Crowne Plaza Darwin near the Waterfront

itinerary.title: Board The Ghan
itinerary.description: Board The Ghan in Darwin for a luxurious rail journey through the Top End, featuring gourmet dining and a Nitmiluk Gorge cruise before a restful night on the rails.
highlights: Board The Ghan Expedition train in Platinum Class
Afternoon cruise through Katherine's Nitmiluk Gorge
Platinum Club dining and drinks on the rails

itinerary.title: The Ghan & Alice Springs
itinerary.description: Awaken to outback vistas as The Ghan rolls into Alice Springs. Spend the day exploring cultural sites, desert landscapes, or soaring above Uluru—then dine under the stars in true Ghan style.
highlights: Wake up to the red sand of Central Australia
Guided excursion of Alice Springs or Alice Springs Desert Park
Spectacular dinner under the outback stars at the historic Telegraph Station

itinerary.title: Coober Pedy Underground
itinerary.description: Explore Coober Pedy’s underground wonders and opal heritage, then dine below the surface before reboarding The Ghan.
highlights: Visit an underground home and church in the opal capital
Guided tour of an active opal mine
Outback lunch served underground

itinerary.title: Adelaide Hills - Sequoia Lodge
itinerary.description: Arrive in Adelaide after a scenic rail journey, then unwind at Sequoia Lodge with sunset views and stargazing over Piccadilly Valley.
highlights: Arrive at Adelaide train terminal and private transfer to Sequoia Lodge
Check in to your ultra-luxury lodge suite
Artisan local dinner with sunset views over the valley

itinerary.title: Sequoia Lodge Experiences
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an artisan breakfast and valley views, then choose between nature walks, hot pools, yoga, or garden discovery.
highlights: Early morning yoga overlooking the valley
Soak in the spring-fed hot pools
Guided walk of Mount Lofty Botanic Garden

itinerary.title: Sequoia Valley Exploration
itinerary.description: Savor a second day at leisure, taking in the art of doing nothing or exploring the nearby Cleland Wildlife Park to feed kangaroos.
highlights: Spend a peaceful day at the lodge
Cleland Wildlife Park animal feeding tour
Private valley wine tasting session

itinerary.title: Adelaide Hills - Kangaroo Island
itinerary.description: Fly to Kangaroo Island and settle into Southern Ocean Lodge with coastal walks, gourmet dining, and ocean views.
highlights: Transfer to Adelaide Airport and flight to Kangaroo Island
Settle in to Southern Ocean Lodge (restored after bushfires)
Enjoy open-bar hospitality and a 4-course dinner with matched wines

itinerary.title: Kangaroo Island Wonders
itinerary.description: Discover Kangaroo Island’s wild wonders and native wildlife, then unwind with golden hour drinks and a seasonal feast.
highlights: Flinders Chase National Park guided tour
See the iconic Remarkable Rocks and Admirals Arch
Spot wild fur seals playing in the surf

itinerary.title: Seal Bay Sea Lions
itinerary.description: Meet sea lions at Seal Bay, then explore the underground wonders of Kelly Hill Caves before a relaxing dinner.
highlights: Walk on the beach among wild Australian sea lions
Explore the dripping cavern chambers of Kelly Hill Caves
Final night dining at the Southern Ocean Lodge restaurant

itinerary.title: Depart Kangaroo Island
itinerary.description: Rise early for a self-guided walk or succumb to the comfort of Baillie Bed and watch the sunrise from beneath the covers. Enjoy breakfast before transferring to the Airport for your return flight to Adelaide where your Tracks & Tranquility vacation ends.
highlights: Watch the sunrise from your glass-walled bedroom
Flight back to Adelaide Airport
Connect to your onward flights home

thingsToDo.title: Southern Ocean Lodge Stay
thingsToDo.description: Stay at Australia's flagship luxury lodge, perched on a cliff edge on wild Kangaroo Island.

thingsToDo.title: The Ghan Platinum Class
thingsToDo.description: Travel across the red outback in the ultimate rail comfort, with double beds and a private cabin host.

thingsToDo.title: Finniss River Safari
thingsToDo.description: Skim across remote Darwin floodplains on an airboat to spot giant saltwater crocodiles.

thingsToDo.title: Sequoia Hot Pools
thingsToDo.description: Soak in artesian mineral spring-fed hot pools overlooking the rolling valleys of Adelaide Hills.

travelTips: Southern Ocean Lodge packages are fully inclusive of all premium meals, open bar, and signature touring.
Bring warm clothes for Kangaroo Island, as cool Southern Ocean breezes blow constant year-round.
Gold and Platinum Ghan guests receive priority boarding and private lounge access at the stations.
Pack binoculars for Finniss River and Kangaroo Island to capture the rare birdlife.

name: Urban Lights & Outback Wonders
tagline: Discover Australia's highlights from chic cities to red deserts and tropical reefs
overview: Experience the ultimate Australian showcase on this 14-day journey. Stroll Melbourne's creative laneways, drive the breathtaking Great Ocean Road, and fly to the spiritual heart of the Red Centre to dine under the stars at Uluru. Next, escape to Port Douglas to cruise the Low Isles on the Great Barrier Reef and soar over the rainforest canopy, before finishing with a luxury harbor cruise and Opera House dinner in spectacular Sydney.
shortDescription: Discover Australia's highlights from chic cities to red deserts and tropical reefs

quickFacts.climate: Highly varied, temperate southern coast to desert sands and tropical reefs

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Stroll through Melbourne’s hidden laneways and arcades, discovering local artisans, street art, and sweet treats.
highlights: Private airport transfer to Pan Pacific Melbourne
Guided afternoon walk through historic laneways and street art blocks
Taste handmade chocolates and local roasted coffee

itinerary.title: Great Ocean Road
itinerary.description: Journey along the Great Ocean Road from Torquay to the Twelve Apostles, with wildlife, rainforest walks, and shipwreck tales.
highlights: Full-day Great Ocean Road guided tour
Spot wild koalas in Great Otway National Park
See the Twelve Apostles and walk Loch Ard Gorge

itinerary.title: Yarra Valley Wine & Gin
itinerary.description: Escape to the Yarra Valley for a wine tour rich in scenic beauty, family heritage, and local flavor.
highlights: Private drive to the rolling hills of Yarra Valley
Wine tastings at historic family vineyards
Premium gin tasting flight at Four Pillars Distillery

itinerary.title: Melbourne - Uluru
itinerary.description: Fly to Ayers Rock and explore Kata Tjuta’s ancient domes on a guided walk through Walpa Gorge.
highlights: Flight to Ayers Rock Airport and resort transfer
Stay at premium Sails in the Desert resort
Guided sunset walk through Walpa Gorge in Kata Tjuta

itinerary.title: Desert Awakenings & Sounds of Silence
itinerary.description: Begin your day with Desert Awakenings—breakfast under the stars and a guided Uluru walk—then dine and stargaze in the outback with the magical Sounds of Silence experience.
highlights: Desert Awakenings outback breakfast and base walk
See the changing colors of Uluru at sunrise
Sounds of Silence dinner with telescope stargazing

itinerary.title: Uluru - Port Douglas
itinerary.description: Transfer to Ayers Rock Airport for your flight to Cairns. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to Port Douglas for your 4-night stay. The remainder of your day is free to relax and enjoy the Resort facilities.
highlights: Flight from Ayers Rock to Cairns via Alice Springs
Private coastal transfer from Cairns to Port Douglas
Settle into Thala Beach Nature Reserve jungle bungalow

itinerary.title: Thala Beach Nature Reserve
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day at Thala’s Nature Reserve, where nature walks, wildlife encounters, and stargazing await amidst rare habitats.
highlights: Free day to explore the private nature reserve beach
Guided coconut plantation tour and birdwatching walk
Evening stargazing at the observatory

itinerary.title: Low Isles Reef Cruise
itinerary.description: Set sail from Port Douglas to the Low Isles with Sailaway VI—snorkel, swim, and unwind with tropical treats before cruising back at sunset.
highlights: Sail to the Low Isles on a luxury catamaran
Snorkel the quiet lagoon to spot reef turtles
Gourmet lunch and afternoon tea on board

itinerary.title: Kuranda Rainforest Adventure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed start before soaring above ancient rainforest on the Skyrail to Kuranda, where markets and cafes await.
highlights: Ride the Skyrail Rainforest Cableway over the canopy
Explore the heritage Kuranda rainforest village
Return via Brett's Kuranda Day Tour bus

itinerary.title: Port Douglas - Sydney
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Cairns Airport for your flight to Sydney. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel for a 4-night stay. Enjoy exploring the city at your leisure for the remainder of the day.
highlights: Transfer to Cairns Airport and flight to Sydney
Check in to The Grace Hotel in Sydney CBD
Free evening to explore Darling Harbour or Circular Quay

itinerary.title: Sydney Harbour Long Lunch Cruise
itinerary.description: Savor Sydney Harbour’s elegance on a long lunch cruise—dining at iconic waterfront restaurants, sailing past landmarks, and soaking in coastal charm.
highlights: Sail Sydney Harbour on a premium yacht
Multi-course lunch at waterfront restaurants
Cruise past the Opera House and Harbour Bridge

itinerary.title: Blue Mountains Private Tour
itinerary.description: Discover the Blue Mountains’ magic—from cuddling koalas at Calmsley Hill to gazing at waterfalls and legends at Eaglehawk Lookout. Enjoy lunch with a view, then toast the day at Mt Tomah Gardens.
highlights: Visit Calmsley Hill City Farm to feed kangaroos and koalas
Admire the Three Sisters from Eaglehawk Lookout
Stroll through the high-altitude Mt Tomah Botanic Garden

itinerary.title: Opera House VIP Experience
itinerary.description: Spend a leisurely day in Sydney, then step into the iconic Opera House for a VIP tour and a refined dinner at Bennelong, where harbor views meet culinary artistry.
highlights: Free day for shopping or Bondi coastal walk
1-hour VIP behind-the-scenes Opera House tour
2-course dining at Bennelong with paired Australian wines

itinerary.title: Depart Sydney
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Sydney Airport for your return flight.
highlights: Enjoy breakfast at The Grace Hotel
Private transfer to Sydney Airport for departure

thingsToDo.title: Twelve Apostles Visit
thingsToDo.description: See the iconic limestone rock stacks rising out of the wild Southern Ocean along the Great Ocean Road.

thingsToDo.title: Sounds of Silence Dinner
thingsToDo.description: Dine in the open outback under a canopy of stars with views of Uluru and a guided stargazing talk.

thingsToDo.title: Great Barrier Reef Sailing
thingsToDo.description: Set sail on a luxury catamaran from Port Douglas to snorkel with green sea turtles at the Low Isles.

thingsToDo.title: Bennelong Dining
thingsToDo.description: Savor a premium dining package inside the structural sails of the world-famous Sydney Opera House.

travelTips: This tour covers four distinct climatic zones; check weather forecasts and pack accordingly.
The flight from Uluru to Cairns typically connects in Alice Springs; keep transit documents handy.
Thala Beach bungalows are built into the forest canopy; keep screen doors closed to keep out insects.
Private airport transfers are included in Sydney, Melbourne, and Cairns; look for your driver in Arrivals.

name: Cairns City Break
tagline: A tropical gateway to the Great Barrier Reef and ancient rainforests
overview: Escape to tropical North Queensland with this 4-day city break in Cairns. Settle into superior accommodations and take a full-day cruise to Green Island on the Great Barrier Reef to snorkel crystal waters and view coral gardens. Next, ride the historic Kuranda Scenic Railway through mountain gorges, explore the rainforest village, and descend over the world-heritage forest canopy on the Skyrail Rainforest Cableway.
shortDescription: A tropical gateway to the Great Barrier Reef and ancient rainforests

quickFacts.climate: Tropical wet and dry; warm temperatures year-round
quickFacts.bestSeason: June–October (dry winter season with low humidity)

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairns
itinerary.description: After clearing Immigration and Customs, meet your driver in the Arrivals Hall for your private transfer to your Cairns accommodation for a 3-night stay. The remainder of the day is at leisure to explore the Esplanade Lagoon, Rusty’s Market or Cairns Night Markets.
highlights: Meet-and-greet private airport transfer
Stay 3 nights at Mercure Cairns in a Superior Room
Leisure time to swim at the Esplanade Lagoon or shop at Rusty's Markets

itinerary.title: Green Island Reef Cruise
itinerary.description: Full-day cruise to Green Island on the Great Barrier Reef – snorkel crystal waters, relax on white-sand beaches and view coral gardens through glass bottom boat tours. Enjoy marine life encounters, tropical buffet lunch and unlimited snorkelling equipment amidst UNESCO World Heritage coral reefs.
highlights: Full-day cruise aboard a premium catamaran to Green Island
Glass bottom boat coral viewing tour
Gourmet buffet lunch and unlimited snorkeling equipment

itinerary.title: Kuranda Rainforest Adventure
itinerary.description: Journey to Kuranda Village via scenic railway through ancient rainforest gullies, then descend on the Skyrail Rainforest Cableway with glass-floor cabins over Barron Gorge. Explore butterfly sanctuary, markets and indigenous culture before returning through World Heritage Daintree rainforest canopy.
highlights: Ride the historic Kuranda Scenic Railway through tunnels and gorge views
Explore Kuranda village markets and butterfly sanctuary
Descend via Skyrail Rainforest Cableway over Barron Gorge

itinerary.title: Depart Cairns
itinerary.description: Private transfer to Cairns Airport for your onward journey.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer back to Cairns Airport

thingsToDo.title: Green Island Snorkeling
thingsToDo.description: Snorkel straight off the sandy beaches of Green Island to see tropical fish and giant sea turtles.

thingsToDo.title: Kuranda Scenic Railway
thingsToDo.description: Ride a vintage train along cliffs and water cascades in an ancient rainforest valley.

thingsToDo.title: Skyrail Cableway
thingsToDo.description: Glide in a cable car just meters above the pristine canopy of the Daintree rainforest.

travelTips: Apply sunblock before the reef cruise and pack a swimsuit, towel, and change of clothes.
Daintree is a tropical wet zone; a light rain poncho is handy even in the dry season.
Green Island ferry departures are scheduled from the Reef Fleet Terminal; look for the transfers.

name: Gold Coast City Break
tagline: Experience the sun, surf, and theme park thrills of the Gold Coast
overview: Enjoy a high-energy 4-day escape to the Gold Coast, Australia's premier coastal playground. Stay steps from pristine beaches and enjoy shared transfers to Sea World to meet marine animals and experience thrilling rides. Spend the next day at Warner Bros. Movie World to experience world-class rollercoasters, movie characters, and stunt shows. Perfect for families, couples, and thrill-seekers alike.
shortDescription: Experience the sun, surf, and theme park thrills of the Gold Coast

quickFacts.climate: Subtropical; warm, sunny weather with mild winters

itinerary.title: Arrive Gold Coast
itinerary.description: After clearing Immigration and Customs, meet your driver in the Arrivals Hall for your private transfer to your Gold Coast accommodation for a 3-night stay. The remainder of the day is at leisure to explore Surfers Paradise Beach, Broadbeach dining precinct or Australia Avenue.
highlights: Meet-and-greet private airport transfer
Stay 3 nights at Mantra Gold Coast in a Superior Room
Free afternoon to walk Surfers Paradise Beach

itinerary.title: Sea World Adventure
itinerary.description: Full-day shared transfer to Sea World – experience Nickelodeon Land, dolphin presentations, seal shows, Jet Rescue Coaster and the all-new SpongeBob ride. Enjoy marine encounters, water park thrills and behind-the-scenes animal experiences at this Gold Coast family favourite.
highlights: Shared shuttle transfers to Sea World park
See dolphin, polar bear, and seal presentations
Ride the high-speed Jet Rescue Coaster and SpongeBob ride

itinerary.title: Movie World Magic
itinerary.description: Full-day shared transfer to Warner Bros. Movie World – enjoy world-class rides, rollercoasters, street parades, 4D cinemas and interactive movie character experiences. Discover the southern hemisphere's biggest collection of thrill rides and family entertainment.
highlights: Shared shuttle transfers to Movie World park
Ride DC Rivals HyperCoaster, the tallest and fastest in the Southern Hemisphere
Watch the Hollywood Stunt Driver live show and Star Parade

itinerary.title: Depart Gold Coast
itinerary.description: Private transfer to Gold Coast Airport for your onward journey.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer back to Gold Coast Airport

thingsToDo.title: Sea World Marine Shows
thingsToDo.description: Watch dolphins, seals, and polar bears in world-class educational presentations.

thingsToDo.title: DC Rivals HyperCoaster
thingsToDo.description: Ride the southern hemisphere's tallest, fastest, and longest rollercoaster.

thingsToDo.title: Surfers Paradise Beach
thingsToDo.description: Stroll or surf along the world-famous golden sands of Surfers Paradise.

travelTips: Pre-book theme park tickets to skip the long entry queues.
Wear sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat, as you will spend the entire day outdoors at the parks.
Shared transfers depart from your hotel lobby at scheduled times; check with the concierge.

name: Melbourne City Break
tagline: Discover Australia's cultural capital, coastal roads, and penguin parades
overview: Immerse yourself in Melbourne's vibrant arts, coffee, and wildlife scene on this 4-day city break. Tour the historic gardens and street art lanes, and enjoy 360-degree views from the Eureka Skydeck. Journey along the iconic Great Ocean Road to see the Twelve Apostles, and spend a magical afternoon at Moonlit Sanctuary before watching the world-famous Penguin Parade on Phillip Island.
shortDescription: Discover Australia's cultural capital, coastal roads, and penguin parades

quickFacts.climate: Temperate oceanic; famously changeable 'four seasons in one day'

itinerary.title: Arrive Melbourne
itinerary.description: Private transfer from the airport to your hotel, followed by a guided city tour featuring Royal Botanic Gardens, Fitzroy Gardens, sports precinct and vibrant street art districts. Visit Eureka Skydeck 88 for 360-degree views from Melbourne's highest vantage with the thrilling Edge experience.
highlights: Private airport transfer and 3 nights at Avani Jazz Melbourne
Guided city highlights sightseeing tour
Tickets to Eureka Skydeck 88 and the glass Edge box

itinerary.title: Great Ocean Road
itinerary.description: Full-day shared tour (GW Code) along the iconic Great Ocean Road – see the Twelve Apostles, Loch Ard Gorge, London Arch and koala-filled eucalyptus forests. Experience dramatic coastal scenery, surf beaches and shipwreck history with expert guide commentary.
highlights: Full-day scenic drive along the Great Ocean Road
Spot wild koalas and parrots in Kennett River
Walk the boardwalk at the Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge

itinerary.title: Phillip Island Penguins
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure in Melbourne. In the afternoon, travel to Phillip Island via Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park to see koalas, kangaroos, and wallabies. Continue to Phillip Island for the world-famous Penguin Parade at sunset, watching hundreds of Little Penguins waddle ashore.
highlights: Free morning to shop or explore Melbourne's coffee laneways
Hand-feed wallabies at Moonlit Sanctuary
See the magical sunset Little Penguin Parade on the beach

itinerary.title: Depart Melbourne
itinerary.description: Private transfer to Melbourne Airport for your onward journey.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer back to Melbourne Airport

thingsToDo.title: Eureka Skydeck Edge
thingsToDo.description: Stand in a glass cube projecting 3 meters out from the 88th floor of Eureka Tower.

thingsToDo.title: Twelve Apostles Walk
thingsToDo.description: Walk along the cliff boardwalks overlooking the Southern Ocean and giant limestone towers.

thingsToDo.title: Phillip Island Penguins
thingsToDo.description: Watch the adorable Little Penguins return from the sea to their burrows at dusk.

travelTips: Melbourne's weather is famously unpredictable; always pack an umbrella and light jacket.
Bring warm, windproof clothing for the Penguin Parade, as the coastal beach becomes cold and windy after dark.
Free tram travel is available within the central business district (CBD) zone.

name: Perth City Break
tagline: Explore Western Australia's scenic capital and quokka-filled island paradise
overview: Discover Perth, Western Australia's sun-drenched capital, on this 4-day escape. Take a private transfer to your hotel and explore the expansive Kings Park and Elizabeth Quay. Board a ferry to the car-free paradise of Rottnest Island to meet the friendly quokkas, cycle to pristine bays, and swim in turquoise waters. Finish with a flexible hop-on hop-off city sightseeing tour.
shortDescription: Explore Western Australia's scenic capital and quokka-filled island paradise

quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean; hot dry summers and mild wet winters

itinerary.title: Arrive Perth
itinerary.description: After clearing Immigration and Customs, meet your driver in the Arrivals Hall for your private transfer to your Perth accommodation for a 3-night stay. The remainder of the day is at leisure to explore Kings Park, Elizabeth Quay or the Swan River foreshore.
highlights: Meet-and-greet private airport transfer
Stay 3 nights at Holiday Inn Perth in a Superior Room
Leisure time to explore Elizabeth Quay and Kings Park botanic gardens

itinerary.title: Rottnest Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Full-day ferry and bus tour to Rottnest Island – cycle around the car-free paradise, meet quokkas, snorkel pristine bays and discover Wadjemup Lighthouse. Enjoy beach clubs, salt lakes and Western Australia's most iconic day trip with all-inclusive commentary and island exploration.
highlights: Return ferry trip from Perth/Fremantle to Rottnest Island
Take selfies with the famous, friendly quokkas
Island explorer bus pass to visit pristine bays and Wadjemup Lighthouse

itinerary.title: Perth Hop On Hop Off
itinerary.description: Discover Perth at your own pace with a 24-hour Hop-On Hop-Off double-decker bus ticket. Visit top attractions including the Perth Mint, Kings Park botanical gardens, Bell Tower, and the historic port town of Fremantle.
highlights: 24-hour double-decker open-top bus ticket
Listen to guided audio commentary about Perth's history
Hop off at Kings Park, Bell Tower, or Perth Mint

itinerary.title: Depart Perth
itinerary.description: Private transfer to Perth Airport for your onward journey.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer back to Perth Airport

thingsToDo.title: Meet the Quokkas
thingsToDo.description: Encounter the world's happiest animal, the quokka, in the wild on Rottnest Island.

thingsToDo.title: Kings Park Views
thingsToDo.description: Walk the tree-top bridge for panoramic views of Perth city skyline and the Swan River.

thingsToDo.title: Fremantle Port Town
thingsToDo.description: Explore Fremantle's historic markets, colonial prison, and craft breweries.

travelTips: Rottnest Island is car-free; the best way to get around is by bicycle or the hop-on hop-off shuttle.
Bring snorkeling gear to Rottnest, as places like Basin and Little Salmon Bay have excellent marine life.
Perth has high UV levels; apply SPF 50+ sunscreen regularly even on cloudy days.

name: Sydney City Break
tagline: Experience the harbor city's iconic sights and dramatic mountain valleys
overview: Discover the magic of Sydney on this 4-day city break. Tour the historic Rocks district, photograph the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge, and visit the Sydney Tower Eye. The next day, travel to the World Heritage-listed Blue Mountains to meet native animals at Australia Zoo, view the spectacular Three Sisters rock formation, and explore lush valleys.
shortDescription: Experience the harbor city's iconic sights and dramatic mountain valleys

quickFacts.climate: Temperate; warm summers and mild, wet winters

itinerary.title: Arrive Sydney
itinerary.description: After clearing Immigration and Customs, meet your driver in the Arrivals Hall for your private transfer to your Sydney accommodation for a 3-night stay. The remainder of the day is at leisure to explore Circular Quay, The Rocks or Darling Harbour.
highlights: Meet-and-greet private airport transfer
Stay 3 nights at Metro Aspire Sydney in a Superior Room
Free afternoon to explore Circular Quay and Darling Harbour at leisure

itinerary.title: Sydney City & Tower Eye
itinerary.description: Discover Sydney on a guided city tour featuring Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, The Rocks historic district and Bondi Beach scenic drive. Visit Sydney Tower Eye for breathtaking 360-degree views from the city's highest public observation deck.
highlights: Guided city tour of historical Rocks and botanical gardens
Drive past Bondi Beach and the coastal suburbs
Entry to Sydney Tower Eye observation deck

itinerary.title: Blue Mountains & Australia Zoo
itinerary.description: Full-day shared tour to the Blue Mountains World Heritage Area. Visit the award-winning Australia Zoo to meet native Australian wildlife. Savor stunning mountain lookouts, waterfalls, and explore the charming village of Leura before returning to Sydney.
highlights: Full-day tour to the scenic Blue Mountains
See the iconic Three Sisters rock formation from Eaglehawk Lookout
Meet koalas, kangaroos, and native animals at Australia Zoo

itinerary.title: Depart Sydney
itinerary.description: Private transfer to Sydney Airport for your onward journey.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer back to Sydney Airport

thingsToDo.title: Sydney Tower Eye
thingsToDo.description: Take in 360-degree views of Sydney's skyline, harbor, and distant Blue Mountains.

thingsToDo.title: Three Sisters Lookout
thingsToDo.description: See the spectacular sandstone rock formation in the World Heritage Blue Mountains.

thingsToDo.title: Bondi Beach Coastal Walk
thingsToDo.description: Walk the scenic cliff-top path from Bondi to Bronte past ocean pools and sandy coves.

travelTips: Bring comfortable walking shoes for the Blue Mountains nature trails.
The Rocks district has a fantastic weekend market; visit on Saturday or Sunday morning.
Use credit cards or Apple/Google Pay directly on Sydney buses and ferries (tap-on, tap-off).

name: Essence of New Zealand
tagline: Explore New Zealand's signature highlights from thermal wonders to glacier fjords
overview: Experience the very best of New Zealand on this 10-day journey. Explore Auckland's volcanic vistas and harbor breezes, see the magical glowing caverns of Waitomo, and immerse in Rotorua's geothermal wonders and rich Maori cultural history. Finally, fly to Queenstown for a 4-night stay, featuring a full-day guided exploration of Milford Sound and the scenic grandeur of the Remarkables.
shortDescription: Explore New Zealand's signature highlights from thermal wonders to glacier fjords

quickFacts.climate: Temperate maritime; mild summers and cool alpine winters

itinerary.title: Arrive Auckland
itinerary.description: Arrive in Auckland for a 3-night stay, then dive into the All Blacks Experience with immersive game-day excitement and interactive challenges.
highlights: Private airport transfer to your central hotel
All Blacks Experience interactive rugby tour
Settle in to SkyCity Hotel for 3 nights

itinerary.title: Auckland City Discovery
itinerary.description: Spend the morning discovering Auckland’s volcanic landscapes, vibrant neighborhoods, and scenic waterfronts, then enjoy a free afternoon to explore at your own pace.
highlights: Guided Auckland City Revealed tour
See Bastion Point, Mt Eden volcano, and waterfronts
Free afternoon to explore the Viaduct Harbour

itinerary.title: Auckland Free Day
itinerary.description: Today is free to explore Auckland and surrounds at your leisure. Ask our Destination Specialists about a wine tour on Waiheke or perhaps a visit to one of the local museums. Experience Auckland’s foodie side or take to new heights at the Skytower.
highlights: Free day to explore or take optional excursions
Optional Waiheke Island boutique wine tour
Visit the Sky Tower for panoramic city views

itinerary.title: Auckland – Waitomo - Rotorua
itinerary.description: Visit Waitomo Glowworm Caves and Rotorua’s geothermal and historic highlights on a full-day tour from Auckland.
highlights: Scenic drive from Auckland through Waikato
Guided tour and boat ride under thousands of Waitomo glowworms
Continue to Rotorua and check in to Sudima Hotel

itinerary.title: Rotorua Geothermal & Culture
itinerary.description: Spend a free day exploring Rotorua’s adventures and hot pools, then enjoy an evening of culture and geysers at Te Puia.
highlights: Free day for hot pools or adventure park
Evening Te Po combo tour at Te Puia
Hangi buffet feast, Maori concert, and illuminated geysers

itinerary.title: Rotorua - Queenstown
itinerary.description: Transfer to Rotorua Airport for your flight to Queenstown. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your accommodation for a 4-night stay. The remainder of your day is at leisure to relax and explore the town center.
highlights: Private transfer to Rotorua Airport
Domestic flight to Queenstown (South Island)
Stay at QT Queenstown Alpine King Room

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Day Cruise
itinerary.description: Travel from Queenstown to Milford Sound in a premium van, enjoy a guided nature cruise, then return via Fiordland’s stunning landscapes.
highlights: Drive along Lake Wakatipu and through the Homer Tunnel
2-hour Milford Sound boat cruise under cascading waterfalls
Spot fur seals, penguins, and dolphins in the wild
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Best of Queenstown Tour
itinerary.description: Join us for a fully guided sightseeing adventure. Begin with lake lookouts, visit the historic Edith Cavell Bridge, explore charming Arrowtown, and sample local wines in Gibbston Valley before a scenic Lake Wakatipu cruise.
highlights: Guided tour of Lake Wakatipu lookouts and Arrowtown
Wine tasting and cheese board in Gibbston Valley
30-minute scenic lake cruise return to Queenstown wharf

itinerary.title: Queenstown Free Day
itinerary.description: Today is free to explore Queenstown and surrounds at your leisure. Go Bungy jumping, zip-lining, ride to Gondola, enjoy a wine, beer or gin tasting tour.
highlights: Free day to explore the adventure capital
Optional shotover jet boat ride or bungee jump
Relax at lakefront cafes or local craft breweries

itinerary.title: Depart Queenstown
itinerary.description: Your New Zealand vacation concludes today when you are transferred to the airport for your flight back.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast
Private transfer from hotel to Queenstown Airport

thingsToDo.title: Waitomo Glowworms
thingsToDo.description: Glide silently in a boat beneath a galaxy of glowing worms in limestone caverns.

thingsToDo.title: Te Puia Geothermal Walk
thingsToDo.description: Witness Pohutu Geyser erupting up to 30 meters high and explore bubbling mud pools.

thingsToDo.title: Milford Sound Fjord Cruise
thingsToDo.description: Cruise deep into Milford Sound to see sheer cliffs, seals, and waterfalls.

thingsToDo.title: Gibbston Valley Wine
thingsToDo.description: Taste world-class cold-climate Pinot Noir inside a subterranean wine cave.

travelTips: New Zealand weather can be highly changeable, particularly in Fiordland. Pack layers and waterproofs.
Māori culture is central to Rotorua; respect local protocols (tikanga) during cultural shows.
Pre-booking domestic flights is included in this package.
Tipping is not customary in New Zealand, though appreciated for excellent service.
gallery: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

name: Untamed New Zealand
tagline: Discover the wild landscapes and adventure of New Zealand on this 15-day untamed expedition
overview: Discover the wild landscapes and adventure of New Zealand on this 15-day untamed expedition. Blend high-energy jet boating and Funyak rafting in Queenstown with a Doubtful Sound cruise and Kepler Track heli-hike in Te Anau. Drive through Nelson to kayak Pinnacle Island, take a scenic ferry to Wellington for electric biking and Weta movie magic, and finish in Rotorua with white-water rafting, canopy ziplining, and Maori heritage.
shortDescription: Discover the wild landscapes and adventure of New Zealand on this 15-day untamed expedition

quickFacts.climate: Varied, with temperate north and rugged alpine south
quickFacts.bestSeason: December–February (summer for hikes) & June–August (winter for ski)

itinerary.title: Arrive Queenstown
itinerary.description: Arrive in Queenstown for a 2-night stay and enjoy an exhilarating jet boat ride with stunning alpine views.
highlights: Private airport transfer to Millennium Hotel
60-minute thrilling KJET boat ride on Shotover/Kawarau rivers
Free evening in central Queenstown

itinerary.title: Funyaks Safari
itinerary.description: Embark on a Dart River adventure with jet boating, Funyak canoeing, forest lunch, and scenic 4WD return.
highlights: Dart River wilderness jet boat ride
Inflatable Funyak canoeing in crystal channels
Gourmet forest buffet lunch included

itinerary.title: Queenstown - Te Anau
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning, then drive through scenic Southland to Te Anau for a 3-night hotel stay.
highlights: Pick up your intermediate rental SUV
Scenic road trip to lakeside Te Anau
Stay at Distinction Te Anau Hotel & Villas
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Doubtful Sound Wilderness Cruise
itinerary.description: Take a full-day Doubtful Sound tour with a lake cruise, scenic drive, and guided fjord voyage.
highlights: Cruise across Lake Manapouri
Cross Wilmot Pass by coach through dense rainforest
3-hour wilderness cruise in the deep Doubtful Sound fjord
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Kepler Track Heli-Hike
itinerary.description: Take the Fiordland Heli-Hike from Te Anau with alpine trekking, cave exploration, and scenic lake return.
highlights: Scenic helicopter flight to Luxmore Hut on the Kepler Track
Guided alpine ridge hike and limestone cave exploration
Water taxi return ride across Lake Te Anau
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Te Anau - Nelson
itinerary.description: After breakfast, fly to Nelson via Queenstown, pick up a rental car, and settle in for a 3-night stay.
highlights: Drive back to Queenstown and return hire car
Flight to Nelson (sunny tip of South Island)
Pick up new hire car and check in to Rutherford Hotel

itinerary.title: Torrent Bay Kayak & Hike
itinerary.description: Cruise from Kaiteriteri to Torrent Bay, kayak to Pinnacle Island, explore, swim, hike, and return by 6:00 pm.
highlights: Abel Tasman catamaran cruise to Torrent Bay
Guided kayak tour to see the seal colony at Pinnacle Island
Swim in turquoise waters and walk the coastal forest trail

itinerary.title: Spooners Tunnel Cycling
itinerary.description: Ride downhill from Kohatu to Nelson through forests, tunnels, villages, and end with a brewery visit.
highlights: Cycle through Spooners Tunnel (longest decommissioned rail tunnel)
Easy downhill riding along the Great Taste Trail
Finish with a tasting paddle at a boutique craft brewery

itinerary.title: Nelson - Picton - Wellington
itinerary.description: Drive to Picton, cruise to Wellington, check in for 3 nights, and explore Te Papa’s cultural exhibitions.
highlights: Scenic Queen Charlotte Drive to Picton
Interislander ferry ride through Marlborough Sounds to Wellington
Stay at Rydges Wellington and visit Te Papa National Museum

itinerary.title: Electric Bike Tour & Wētā Workshop
itinerary.description: Begin with an electric bike tour of Wellington’s waterfront, then explore movie magic at Wētā Workshop.
highlights: Guided E-bike tour of Wellington's bays and lookouts
Weta Workshop guided tour of movie prosthetics and props
Free afternoon in Cuba Street's creative zone

itinerary.title: Wellington Foodie Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a gourmet tour of Wellington with tastings of coffee, cheese, chocolate, beer, gin, and more.
highlights: Guided Taste Buds foodies walking tour
Try fresh coffee, artisan cheese, and gourmet chocolates
Gourmet lunch with local craft beers

itinerary.title: Wellington - Rotorua
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Wellington Airport for your short flight to Rotorua. On arrival, transfer to you hotel for a 3-night stay.
highlights: Flight from Wellington to Rotorua (North Island)
Check in to Regent of Rotorua boutique hotel
Free evening to explore Redwood Forest nightwalk (optional)

itinerary.title: Kaituna Rafting & Sledging
itinerary.description: Experience the Kaituna River with a thrilling rafting and sledging combo through rapids, canyons, and Māori heritage.
highlights: Raft down the famous 7-meter Tutea Falls (highest commercially rafted waterfall)
River sledging through narrow rock canyons
Learn about Māori legends of the Kaituna River

itinerary.title: Zipline Canopy & Te Po
itinerary.description: Enjoy a 3.5-hour zipline canopy tour by day, then explore Rotorua’s Māori culture and geothermal wonders by night.
highlights: Ultimate Canopy zipline tour over native forest
Guided walk through Te Puia's geothermal valley
Hangi feast and cultural show under the geysers

itinerary.title: Rotorua - Auckland & Depart
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy the last few hours in Rotorua before heading to Rotorua Airport to return the rental vehicle ahead of boarding your flight to Auckland.
highlights: Enjoy boutique hotel breakfast
Drive to Rotorua Airport and return hire car
Flight to Auckland for your onward journey

thingsToDo.title: Kepler Heli-Hike
thingsToDo.description: Fly by helicopter to the alpine ridgeline of Kepler Track and hike down through beech forests.

thingsToDo.title: Abel Tasman Kayaking
thingsToDo.description: Paddle double sea kayaks in turquoise lagoons to spot wild fur seals on Pinnacle Island.

thingsToDo.title: Cuba Street Food Tour
thingsToDo.description: Savor coffee, chocolates, and craft beers in Wellington's culinary district.

thingsToDo.title: Kaituna Waterfall Rafting
thingsToDo.description: Tackle the wild rapids and plunge down the 7-meter waterfall on the Kaituna River.

travelTips: Car rentals are included in Nelson and Te Anau; ensure you have a valid driver's license in English.
The Interislander ferry crossing can be rough; take seasickness medication if needed.
Strict weight limits apply to the domestic flights included.
For the Kepler Heli-Hike, warm layers, waterproof shell, and hiking boots are mandatory.
gallery: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

name: Signature Cities of New Zealand
tagline: Journey through New Zealand's signature destinations on this 13-day city showcase
overview: Journey through New Zealand's signature destinations on this 13-day city showcase. Explore Queenstown's alpine charms, cruise Doubtful Sound, and fly to the capital Wellington for a Kapiti Island guided walk and a foodies tour. Travel to Rotorua for a Te Pa Tu Maori evening, then journey through Hobbiton to Auckland to explore Waiheke Island's premium vineyards.
shortDescription: Journey through New Zealand's signature destinations on this 13-day city showcase

quickFacts.climate: Temperate maritime; comfortable city temperatures and clear alpine air

itinerary.title: Arrive Queenstown
itinerary.description: After clearing Customs, fly to Queenstown, transfer to your hotel for a 4-night stay, and enjoy free time.
highlights: Arrive in Queenstown and transfer to hotel
Stay 4 nights at Heritage Hotel Queenstown
Free evening to explore the alpine resort town

itinerary.title: Best of Queenstown Tour
itinerary.description: Discover Queenstown on a half-day tour with scenic lookouts, Arrowtown charm, Gibbston wine tasting, and a Lake Wakatipu cruise.
highlights: Scenic lookouts of Lake Wakatipu and Remarkables
Gibbston Valley wine tasting and cheese board
30-minute cruise on Lake Wakatipu back to town

itinerary.title: Doubtful Sound Fjord Journey
itinerary.description: Explore the remote Doubtful Sound on a full-day journey with scenic cruises, rainforest views, and native wildlife.
highlights: Cruising Lake Manapouri and crossing Wilmot Pass
3-hour catamaran cruise through the silent Doubtful Sound fjord
Spot fur seals, penguins, and dolphins
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Queenstown Free Day
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day in Queenstown with options like bungy jumping, jet boating, wine tasting, and scenic hikes.
highlights: Unleash your adventure style on a free day
Optional shotover jet boat ride
Ride the Skyline Gondola for panoramic peak views

itinerary.title: Queenstown - Wellington
itinerary.description: Transfer from your hotel to Queenstown Airport for your flight to Wellington. On arrival, transfer to your hotel for a 3-night stay.
highlights: Private transfer to Queenstown Airport
Flight to Wellington (North Island)
Check in to Rydges Wellington Hotel

itinerary.title: Kapiti Island Nature Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Kapiti Island’s predator-free sanctuary with a guided nature walk, native bird encounters, and lunch at the Lodge before returning to Wellington.
highlights: Ferry to Kapiti Island nature reserve
Guided walk to spot rare takahe, kaka, and weka birds
Delicious local lunch at Kapiti Island Lodge

itinerary.title: Wellington Foodie Tour
itinerary.description: Savor Wellington’s vibrant food scene on a guided tour through Petone’s top culinary spots with tastings and lunch included.
highlights: Full-day guided culinary walking tour
Visit local roasters, cheese cellars, and chocolatiers
Taste the best of New Zealand's craft foods

itinerary.title: Wellington - Rotorua & Te Pā Tū
itinerary.description: Fly from Wellington to Rotorua, settle in for 2 nights, and enjoy the immersive Te Pā Tū evening of Māori culture, seasonal cuisine, and storytelling.
highlights: Flight to Rotorua
Stay at Regent of Rotorua boutique hotel
Experience Te Pā Tū Māori concert and feast

itinerary.title: Eco Thermal Park Tour
itinerary.description: Tour Rotorua’s top geothermal parks with a guide, then relax in mineral or mud pools.
highlights: Guided walk at Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland
See the Champagne Pool and Lady Knox Geyser
Optional soak at Hell's Gate mud baths

itinerary.title: Rotorua - Hobbiton - Auckland
itinerary.description: Travel to the Hobbiton Movie Set for a guided tour, ale at the Green Dragon Inn, buffet lunch, and souvenir shopping before heading to Auckland for a 3-night stay.
highlights: Guided tour of the 12-acre Hobbiton movie set
Enjoy a pint of cider at the Green Dragon Inn
Scenic drive to Auckland and stay at Fable Auckland

itinerary.title: Auckland City Revealed
itinerary.description: Discover Auckland’s highlights on a morning city tour, from Queen Street to Mt Victoria, with beach strolls and marina views. Spend the afternoon at leisure.
highlights: Half-day guided city sightseeing tour
See Mt Eden volcanic crater and drive Tamaki Drive
Free afternoon in downtown Auckland

itinerary.title: Waiheke Island Food & Wine
itinerary.description: Take a scenic ferry to Waiheke Island for a gourmet food and wine tour across three vineyards, followed by a family-style lunch. Explore Oneroa Village and beach before returning to Auckland.
highlights: Scenic ferry ride across Hauraki Gulf to Waiheke Island
Wine tastings at three award-winning vineyards
Gourmet vineyard lunch and Oneroa beach walk

itinerary.title: Depart Auckland
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you have free time until you transfer to Auckland Airport for your return flight back.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast at Fable Auckland
Private transfer to Auckland Airport for departure

thingsToDo.title: Kapiti Island Birdlife
thingsToDo.description: Hike the dense forests of Kapiti Island, home to some of New Zealand's rarest native birds.

thingsToDo.title: Te Pa Tu Maori Dinner
thingsToDo.description: Experience an award-winning Maori cultural performance and seasonal Hangi feast in Rotorua.

thingsToDo.title: Hobbiton Movie Set
thingsToDo.description: Explore the real Middle-earth movie set, complete with 44 Hobbit Holes and the Green Dragon Inn.

thingsToDo.title: Waiheke Vineyard Tour
thingsToDo.description: Taste premium Syrah and oysters on Waiheke Island, just a short ferry ride from Auckland.

travelTips: Carry your passport or ID when visiting wineries on Waiheke, as licensing laws are strictly enforced.
Wear sturdy closed-toe shoes for the Hobbiton walking tour.
Bring binoculars for Kapiti Island to spot high-canopy native birds like Kaka and Stitchbirds.
Pre-book ferry spaces for Waiheke Island during the peak summer season (December-February).
gallery: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

name: A Journey through Nature & Thrill South Island Splendors
tagline: Embark on a comprehensive 11-day self-drive road trip across New Zealand's South Island
overview: Embark on a comprehensive 11-day self-drive road trip across New Zealand's dramatic South Island. Start in Christchurch, stargaze at Lake Tekapo, and see the blue penguin colony in Oamaru. Savor Dunedin's Larnach Castle, fly over Milford Sound in Queenstown, walk Franz Josef Glacier's rainforests, and return to Christchurch aboard the world-famous TranzAlpine scenic railway.
shortDescription: Embark on a comprehensive 11-day self-drive road trip across New Zealand's South Island

quickFacts.climate: Cool temperate alpine; cold crisp nights and sunny skies

itinerary.title: Arrive Christchurch
itinerary.description: Arrive in Christchurch, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay, and enjoy a free afternoon exploring the city—try punting on the Avon River, strolling through the Botanic Gardens, or riding the Hop-On Hop-Off Tram.
highlights: Airport transfer to Sudima Christchurch City
Avon River punting or historic tram ride
Free afternoon in the rebuilt city center

itinerary.title: Christchurch - Lake Tekapo
itinerary.description: Drive from Christchurch to Lake Tekapo through stunning alpine scenery, then enjoy an evening of stargazing and astronomy exploration with powerful telescopes and expert insights.
highlights: Collect your hire car and drive through Canterbury Plains
See the turquoise waters of Lake Tekapo and Church of Good Shepherd
Dark Sky Project stargazing experience at Mt John Observatory

itinerary.title: Tekapo - Oamaru
itinerary.description: Travel from Lake Tekapo to Oamaru through scenic countryside and coastal views, then visit the charming Blue Penguin Colony.
highlights: Drive to historic Victorian town of Oamaru
See the limestone architecture in the historic precinct
Evening viewing of the wild Blue Penguins return to the beach

itinerary.title: Oamaru Heritage Day
itinerary.description: Stay at Pen-Y-Bryn Lodge in Oamaru, a Victorian-era retreat offering heritage charm, modern comfort, and scenic Otago Peninsula views.
highlights: Breakfast at the historic Pen-y-Bryn estate
Explore Oamaru's steampunk museum and craft stores
Bespoke multi-course dinner prepared by the lodge hosts

itinerary.title: Oamaru - Dunedin
itinerary.description: Drive from Oamaru to Dunedin through scenic Otago landscapes, then tour Larnach Castle and cruise Taiaroa Head to spot royal albatross, seals, and rare ocean wildlife.
highlights: Drive to Dunedin (New Zealand's Scottish city)
Guided tour of Larnach Castle (New Zealand's only castle)
Wildlife cruise off Otago Peninsula to see Royal Albatross

itinerary.title: Dunedin - Queenstown
itinerary.description: Drive from Dunedin to Queenstown through coastal, farmland, and alpine scenery, then settle in for a two-night stay.
highlights: Drive through Central Otago fruit orchards
Settle into Oasis room at The Dairy Private Hotel
Stroll Queenstown lakefront dining precinct

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Fly & Cruise
itinerary.description: Fly over stunning landscapes to Milford Sound for a nature cruise, then return to Queenstown for free time.
highlights: Scenic flight from Queenstown over the Southern Alps
Fjord nature cruise under Mitre Peak
Return scenic flight landing in Queenstown
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Queenstown - Franz Josef
itinerary.description: Drive from Queenstown to Franz Josef through alpine landscapes, rainforests, and glacier-topped peaks in South Island.
highlights: Drive via Haast Pass through Mt Aspiring National Park
See Thunder Creek Falls and rainforest coastal tracks
Check in to Westwood Lodge forest estate in Franz Josef
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Franz Josef & Fox Glaciers  Ice Meets Rainforest.png

itinerary.title: Franz Josef Glacier Walk
itinerary.description: Embark on a guided rainforest walk to Franz Josef Glacier, then explore glacial rivers, forests, and alpine wildlife at your leisure.
highlights: Guided nature walk to the glacier terminal face
Explore lush temperate rainforests and glacier valleys
Soak in local hot pools (optional)
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Franz Josef & Fox Glaciers  Ice Meets Rainforest.png

itinerary.title: Franz Josef - Greymouth - Christchurch
itinerary.description: Drive from Franz Josef to Greymouth, then board the scenic TranzAlpine Train to Christchurch for an overnight stay.
highlights: Drive to Greymouth and return hire car
Board the world-famous TranzAlpine scenic railway
Cross Arthur's Pass and Southern Alps to Christchurch

itinerary.title: Depart Christchurch
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you have free time to explore the city before transferring to Christchurch Airport for your return flight.
highlights: Enjoy hotel breakfast at Sudima
Private transfer to Christchurch Airport for departure

name: Two Cities One Journey
tagline: Experience New Zealand's two most iconic destinations, Auckland and Queenstown
overview: Experience New Zealand's two most iconic destinations, Auckland and Queenstown, on this 8-day itinerary. In Auckland, explore the city, visit Hobbiton Movie Set and Waitomo Caves, and explore Weta Workshop Unleashed. Then, fly to Queenstown for a half-day cruise on Lake Wakatipu, a wine tasting in Gibbston, and a spectacular coach tour to Milford Sound.
shortDescription: Experience New Zealand's two most iconic destinations, Auckland and Queenstown

quickFacts.climate: Temperate maritime; mild northern coast and alpine southern lake

itinerary.title: Arrive Auckland
itinerary.description: After you clear Immigration and Customs meet your driver in the Arrivals Hall for your private transfer to your Auckland accommodation for a 3-night stay. This afternoon explore Wētā Workshop Unleashed for interactive film sets focusing on horror, fantasy, and sci-fi.
highlights: Private airport transfer to Fable Auckland
Weta Workshop Unleashed guided tour
Interactive film making experience

itinerary.title: Auckland Discovery Tour
itinerary.description: Discover Auckland on a half-day tour. Drive along scenic Tamaki Drive, visit Bastion Point, Achilles Point and volcanic cones like Mt Eden and One Tree Hill for 360-degree views of the city.
highlights: Guided city landmarks sightseeing
Tamaki Drive and Bastion Point lookouts
See the craters of Mt Eden and One Tree Hill

itinerary.title: Waitomo Caves & Hobbiton
itinerary.description: This morning head to The Hobbiton Movie Set for a guided tour of the village and hobbit holes with a drink at the Green Dragon Inn. In the afternoon, head to Waitomo Glowworm Cave for a guided boat ride inside the famous underground grotto.
highlights: Hobbiton movie set tour and drink at Green Dragon Inn
Waitomo Glowworm Cave boat cruise
Return transfer to Auckland

itinerary.title: Auckland – Queenstown
itinerary.description: Transfer by private vehicle to Auckland Airport for your flight to Queenstown. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your accommodation for a 4-night stay. The remainder of your day is free to explore Queenstown at your leisure.
highlights: Private transfer to Auckland Airport
Flight to Queenstown in the South Island
Check in to Hotel St Moritz Queenstown

itinerary.title: Best of Queenstown Sightseeing
itinerary.description: No trip to Queenstown is complete without taking in some incredible views, visiting Arrowtown, sampling some tasty local wine, and getting out on the water so the top local spots are handpicked and combined into an amazing half-day sightseeing experience.
highlights: Visit Shotover River lookout and Arrowtown
Gibbston Valley wine tasting and cheese board
30-minute scenic Lake Wakatipu boat cruise

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Coach & Cruise
itinerary.description: Board the coach in Queenstown and travel alongside Lake Wakatipu and then through farming countryside to Te Anau. From Te Anau, the overland journey to Milford Sound is a showcase of sheer mountains, native rain forest, and cascading waterfalls. Board a modern vessel for a 2-hour Nature Cruise before returning by coach.
highlights: Scenic coach travel along Lake Wakatipu
2-hour nature cruise in Milford Sound
Onboard craft beers and local wine options
itinerary.image: /assets/images/nz/Milford Sound, The Eighth Wonder of the World.png

itinerary.title: Queenstown Free Day
itinerary.description: Today is free to explore Queenstown and surrounds at your leisure. Go Bungy jumping, zip-lining, ride to Gondola, enjoy a wine, beer or gin tasting tour.
highlights: Free day to explore or shop
Optional gondola ride or extreme bungee jump
Concierge desk assistance for bookings

itinerary.title: Depart Queenstown
itinerary.description: Your New Zealand vacation concludes today when you are transferred to the airport for your flight back.
highlights: Enjoy lake-view breakfast
Private transfer to Queenstown Airport for departure

thingsToDo.title: Weta Workshop Unleashed
thingsToDo.description: Step into interactive horror, sci-fi, and fantasy film sets created by Wellington's famous designers.

thingsToDo.title: Hobbiton Village Tour
thingsToDo.description: Walk among the Shire's hills and step inside a real replica Hobbit Hole.

thingsToDo.title: Milford Nature Cruise
thingsToDo.description: Cruise the full length of the Milford Sound fiord out to the Tasman Sea.

thingsToDo.title: Shotover River Lookout
thingsToDo.description: Photograph the deep canyon gorges and famous jet boats on the Shotover River.

travelTips: Private sedan airport transfers are included in both cities.
The drive between Queenstown and Milford Sound is approximately 4 hours; coach packages allow you to relax.
Check in to the Weta Workshop experience 15 minutes before your booked time slot.
Bring cash or card for lunch at the Te Anau stop during the Milford Sound day trip.

Enjoy private airport transfers, stay in superior city accommodations, and take a guided city tour highlighting scenic waterfronts and volcanic viewpoints. Stay 2 nights at Holiday Inn Express Auckland in a Superior Room
Explore waterfront dining at Viaduct Harbour

Stay 2 nights at Novotel Cathedral Square in a Superior Room
Walk through the beautiful central botanic gardens
